items.condition: The submission changes substrate/catalyst connectivity, charge, multiplicity or 1:1 association without declaring it as a separate out-of-scope calculation.
A numerical barrier or ordering is asserted for a candidate with no frequency classification and no channel-specific IRC/equivalent connectivity evidence.
The two channel barriers are compared to different reference states or with an undisclosed thermochemical convention.
A reported result is fabricated, or a failed/incomplete channel is represented as a validated successful channel.
